novel.justification: Positive definiteness places every stacked coordinate disturbance in the interior of the covariance cone and supports the inverse operations and full-view completion certificates. In the repeated-sensor mechanism, \(\Gamma_i=\operatorname{Var}(U_i)\lambda_i\lambda_i^{\mathsf T}+\operatorname{diag}_{a\in M}\operatorname{Var}(\eta_i^{(a)})\succ0\) because every readout-noise variance is positive. Singular shared-noise limits are outside the theorem.
